answer.code: browser-relay eval "(()=>{const ed=window.editor;const shapes=ed.getCurrentPageShapes();const geos=shapes.filter(s=>s.type==='geo'&&s.props.geo==='rectangle');geos.sort((a,b)=>a.x-b.x);const labels=geos.map(s=>s.props.richText?ed.getShapeText(s.id):'');const nodes=geos.map(s=>({label:ed.getShapeText(s.id),x:s.x,y:s.y,w:s.props.w,h:s.props.h}));const arrows=shapes.filter(s=>s.type==='arrow').length;let overlap=false;for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<nodes.length;j++){const a=nodes[i],b=nodes[j];if(a.x<b.x+b.w&&b.x<a.x+a.w&&a.y<b.y+b.h&&b.y<a.y+a.h)overlap=true;}window.__bench_finding={labels,nodes,arrows,overlap};return JSON.stringify(window.__bench_finding)})()"
